Workflow.Name: Change Radar handler: Digest-Email
Workflow.Description: Change Radar handler Digest-Email: every Monday, the week's queued Digest-Email runs as one email to each email: entry in alert_destinations, as the owner of the Office 365 Outlook connection (crdr_outlook). Sends only (writes = no; ADR 0011 addendum). Ships off, with its subscriptions disabled.
